system.description: Mind-altering powers and even simple threats break you easily. You get no test against Dominate, though you remain immune to Dominate from Cainites of weaker generation, and you suffer a two-Trait penalty on all Mental and Social Challenges. You cannot exceed three Willpower Traits, regardless of generation, unless you overcome this Flaw.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
